title: Tossed Skillet Lasagna with Zucchini, Carrot, Ricotta & Basil

steps.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Break lasagna noodles into thirds. Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add salt and broken noodles, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Once done, drain in a colander and set aside.
While the noodles are cooking, trim the zucchini and carrots. Run the peeler along the zucchini and carrots to make long, noodle-like strips. Place both in a medium bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes; add to the bowl with the zucchini and carrot.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.

When the veggies are done, add lasagna noodles, half of the basil, and tomato sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 2 minutes. Remove lasagna from heat. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Top lasagna with dollops of ricotta and sprinkle with mozzarella.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide lasagna between plates or bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
